operation: A Brazilian non-financial company (CNPJ; not an investment fund, not a financial institution) buys USDT on Foxbit with reais sent by Pix and withdraws it to its own self-custodied wallet
assumptions: A1=The company completed Foxbit's company onboarding and its verification was approved|A2=The reais leave a bank account held under the company's own CNPJ|A3=Foxbit's compliance set the company's BRL deposit and crypto withdrawal limits at or above the case amount (100,000 USDT, about R$ 540k)|A4=Foxbit's commercial team approved the company's stablecoin (digital-dollar) operations|A5=The company controls the keys of the destination TRC-20 address and declares it as its own wallet
